scope: Sequence-aware neural action control from eleven verified demonstrations; PCA RGB features are fixed and train-only
development: Familiar training starts and the eight exposed robustness development/test positions; none are called unseen again
selection: Train and diagnose on familiar/exposed development starts only. Freeze candidate weights, code and new test states before one final neural-versus-retrieval comparison. Do not tune from held-out outcomes in this goal.
success: Unchanged physical evaluator: supported grasp/lift/hold, upright placement/release, parked other arm and limited disturbance. No runtime teacher, attachments, object-pose inputs or resets after initial setup.
caveat: A recurrent model may learn elapsed-step behavior implicitly. Actuator-pause and camera-rejection checks are needed; familiar success does not prove generalization.
